errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос (ордината) е етикетирана с числови стойности
errors.evidence: The description states that the vertical axis is labeled with numerical values. In the figure, the vertical axis has no labels or tick marks. The numerical values are data labels placed on top of the bars.
The description fails to mention the range of the values on the y-axis (from 0 to 47), which is a required element according to the prompt ("диапазонът от стойности").
